How much is admission?

What time does it open?

dialogue.en: Hi, two tickets, please.
That comes to forty dollars.
How much is admission?
Twenty dollars per person.
Is there a student discount?
Yes, with a student ID.

phrases.en: Is the special exhibition included?
Can I buy a timed-entry ticket?
Do children under five need a ticket?
phrases.zh: 五岁以下儿童需要票吗？

phrases.en: Can I re-enter with the same ticket?
phrases.zh: 同一张票能再次入场吗？

phrases.en: Is there a combo ticket with the museum next door?

dialogue.en: Is the special exhibition included?
No, it's an extra ten dollars.
Okay. Can I buy a timed-entry ticket?
Yes, choose a time slot online.
Do children under five need a ticket?
dialogue.zh: 五岁以下儿童需要票吗？

dialogue.en: No, they're free.
Good. Can I re-enter with the same ticket?
dialogue.zh: 好。同一张票能再次入场吗？

dialogue.en: Only on the same day.
Great. Is there a combo ticket with the museum next door?
dialogue.zh: 好。和隔壁博物馆有联票吗？

dialogue.en: The combo saves five dollars.

phrases.en: The website says the museum is open late on Fridays. Is that still true?
phrases.zh: 网站说周五晚开门。还有吗？

phrases.en: I bought a ticket for 2 p.m., but my train is delayed. Can I change the time?
phrases.zh: 我买了下午 2 点的票，但火车延误。能改时间吗？

phrases.en: Is there a guided tour in Mandarin?
Can I get a refund if the exhibit is closed?
phrases.zh: 如果展览关闭能退款吗？

phrases.en: Do you offer a membership that includes both museums?
phrases.zh: 有包含两个博物馆的会员吗？

dialogue.en: The website says the museum is open late on Fridays. Is that still true?
dialogue.zh: 网站说周五晚开门。还有吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, until 9 p.m.
Good. I bought a ticket for 2 p.m., but my train is delayed. Can I change the time?
dialogue.zh: 好。我买了下午 2 点的票，但火车延误。能改时间吗？

dialogue.en: I can move you to the next available slot.
dialogue.zh: 我可以给您改到下一个时段。

dialogue.en: Thank you. Is there a guided tour in Mandarin?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。有普通话导览团吗？

dialogue.en: The Mandarin tour starts at 3 p.m.
dialogue.zh: 普通话团下午 3 点开始。

dialogue.en: Great. Can I get a refund if the exhibit is closed?
dialogue.zh: 好。如果展览关闭能退款吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, full refund at the desk.
Good. Do you offer a membership that includes both museums?
dialogue.zh: 好。有包含两个博物馆的会员吗？

dialogue.en: The dual membership covers both for a year.
dialogue.zh: 双馆会员一年内两个都含。

phrases.en: Where is the entrance?
Can I bring a backpack?
Is photography allowed?
Is there a restroom nearby?

dialogue.en: Excuse me, where is the entrance?
Around the corner, past the statue.
Thanks. Can I bring a backpack?
Yes, but large bags must be checked.
Is photography allowed?
No flash, please.

phrases.en: Do I need to check my umbrella?
Is there a coat check?
Can I bring water inside?
Are strollers allowed in the galleries?
Where is the accessible entrance?

dialogue.en: Do I need to check my umbrella?
Yes, at the desk by the door.
Okay. Is there a coat check?
It's next to the ticket counter.
Can I bring water inside?
Sealed bottles are fine.
Good. Are strollers allowed in the galleries?
Yes, but use the elevator, not the stairs.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但用电梯，不要走楼梯。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Where is the accessible entrance?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。无障碍入口在哪里？

dialogue.en: On the left side of the building.

phrases.en: The main entrance has a long line. Is there a members' entrance?
phrases.zh: 正门排长队。有会员入口吗？

phrases.en: I have a stroller and a toddler. Is there a family entrance with an elevator?
phrases.zh: 我推婴儿车带幼儿。有带电梯的家庭入口吗？

phrases.en: Can I leave a suitcase at the coat check?
phrases.zh: 能把行李箱寄存在衣帽间吗？

phrases.en: The gallery is closing in ten minutes. Can I stay a little longer?
phrases.zh: 展厅十分钟后关。能多待一会儿吗？

phrases.en: Is there a quiet room for nursing mothers?

dialogue.en: The main entrance has a long line. Is there a members' entrance?
dialogue.zh: 正门排长队。有会员入口吗？

dialogue.en: Members enter through the side door on 5th Street.
Great. I have a stroller and a toddler. Is there a family entrance with an elevator?
dialogue.zh: 好。我推婴儿车带幼儿。有带电梯的家庭入口吗？

dialogue.en: Use the accessible entrance on the left.
Thanks. Can I leave a suitcase at the coat check?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。能把行李箱寄存在衣帽间吗？

dialogue.en: Only small bags. Suitcases go in the lockers.
dialogue.zh: 只能小包。行李箱放储物柜。

dialogue.en: Okay. The gallery is closing in ten minutes. Can I stay a little longer?
dialogue.zh: 好。展厅十分钟后关。能多待一会儿吗？

dialogue.en: The guard needs to clear the room at six.
I understand. Is there a quiet room for nursing mothers?
It's next to the first-aid station.

phrases.en: Where does the tour start?
How long is the tour?
Is the tour in English?
Can I join the next tour?

dialogue.en: Excuse me, where does the tour start?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，导览从哪里开始？

dialogue.en: Right here, by the information desk.
How long is the tour?
About ninety minutes.
Is the tour in English?
Yes, and there's a Mandarin tour at three.
dialogue.zh: 是英语，三点还有普通话团。

phrases.en: Does the tour include the special exhibition?
Can I leave the tour early?
Are there headsets for hearing-impaired visitors?
Is there a discount if I book online?
Can I take photos during the tour?

dialogue.en: Does the tour include the special exhibition?
It ends at the exhibition entrance.
Okay. Can I leave the tour early?
Of course. Just tell me so I don't wait.
dialogue.zh: 当然。告诉我一声，我就不等了。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Are there headsets for hearing-impaired visitors?
Yes, ask at the desk.
Good. Is there a discount if I book online?
Online tickets are two dollars cheaper.
Great. Can I take photos during the tour?
Yes, but no flash inside the galleries.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但展厅内不要开闪光灯。

phrases.en: The tour is sold out. Can I join a waitlist?
Our guide is speaking too fast. Can you ask her to slow down?
phrases.zh: 导游说得太快。能让她慢一点吗？

phrases.en: I'm hard of hearing. Is there a written transcript of the tour?
phrases.zh: 我听力不好。有导览文字稿吗？

phrases.en: The tour skipped the sculpture garden. Can we go back?
phrases.zh: 导览跳过了雕塑园。能回去吗？

phrases.en: Can we arrange a private tour for a group of six?
phrases.zh: 能给六人团安排私人导览吗？

dialogue.en: The tour is sold out. Can I join a waitlist?
I'll add your name. There are usually no-shows.
dialogue.zh: 我加你名字。通常有人不来。

dialogue.en: Thank you. Our guide is speaking too fast. Can you ask her to slow down?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。导游说得太快。能让她慢一点吗？

dialogue.en: I'll pass the message along.
I'm hard of hearing. Is there a written transcript of the tour?
dialogue.zh: 我听力不好。有导览文字稿吗？

dialogue.en: We have a large-print summary at the desk.
Good. The tour skipped the sculpture garden. Can we go back?
dialogue.zh: 好。导览跳过了雕塑园。能回去吗？

dialogue.en: The garden closes at five, but you can visit it on your own.
dialogue.zh: 雕塑园五点关，但可以自己去。

dialogue.en: Okay. Can we arrange a private tour for a group of six?
dialogue.zh: 好。能给六人团安排私人导览吗？

dialogue.en: I can book one for tomorrow morning.
